description: Paris 18e: POI 'Café des 2 Moulins' also carries alt_name 'Café des Deux Moulins' (4 words against 3). Both names are one object in the POI name index, so each token keeps one of them: café, des and moulins read the alt name (no unmatched word, 2 other words found) and the number 2 has no word of it, so the query falls apart and '2 Rue des Moulins' (1er, a house node of an associatedStreet relation) wins 2.1 km away. The generator marks an other name with another number of words (altnamecommon1..7) and the search reads it as its own object. The extract carries the named cafes, restaurants and bars and the named streets (two nodes each) of Montmartre so that café, des and rue stay common words as on the full map.
